lines.zh: 我踩着落叶，尾巴举得高高的。
lines.en: I step through fallen leaves, my tail held high.

lines.zh: 四条短腿倒腾得很快。
lines.en: My four short legs hustle along.

lines.zh: 沿着倒木走，比踩泥地舒服。
lines.en: Walking along a fallen log beats muddy ground.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边闻，路就没走直。
lines.en: I sniff as I walk, so my path wanders.

lines.zh: 黑白条纹在蕨叶间一闪一闪。
lines.en: My black and white stripes flicker between the ferns.

lines.zh: 前面有味道，我绕过去看看。
lines.en: There is a smell ahead; I will circle around it.

lines.zh: 我走得很小心，脚下不留声音。
lines.en: I walk carefully and leave no sound behind.

lines.zh: 灌木底下最安全，我贴着走。
lines.en: Under the bushes is safest, so I hug them.

lines.zh: 我停下来，把鼻子抬向风。
lines.en: I stop and lift my nose into the wind.

lines.zh: 肚子贴地，我从两根树根间挤过。
lines.en: Belly to the ground, I squeeze between two roots.

lines.zh: 走远一点，别踩到我的尾巴。
lines.en: Keep your distance; don't step on my tail.

lines.zh: 这条小路我熟，通向浆果丛。
lines.en: I know this little trail; it leads to berry bushes.

lines.zh: 跟我走，别踩我尾巴。
lines.en: Follow me. Don't step on my tail.

lines.zh: 我短腿在落叶里走得稳。
lines.en: My short legs walk steady through the fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 我这身条纹，是提醒你的。
lines.en: These stripes are a warning to you.

lines.zh: 我边走边嗅，慢慢晃过去。
lines.en: I sniff as I go, ambling over.

lines.zh: 黑白条纹，是在提醒你。
lines.en: Black and white stripes are my warning.

lines.zh: 这片林子，我慢慢看。
lines.en: These woods — I'll take my time looking.

lines.zh: 森林的阴凉处才舒服。
lines.en: Only the forest shade feels right.

lines.zh: 我一小步一小步，也能到。
lines.en: One small step at a time, and I'll get there.

lines.zh: 别催，我这短腿在赶。
lines.en: Don't rush me. These short legs are moving.

lines.zh: 我腿酸了，啃两口草。
lines.en: My legs ache; I nibble some grass.

lines.zh: 尾巴翘起来了，只警告一次。
lines.en: Tail up — this is your only warning.

lines.zh: 我看前面那片草挺嫩。
lines.en: That grass ahead looks tender to me.

lines.zh: 雨要来了，我得找树荫。
lines.en: Rain's coming. I need shade.

lines.zh: 哪片草甜，我门儿清。
lines.en: I know exactly which patch tastes sweet.

lines.zh: 森林的影子别踩乱。
lines.en: Don't mess up the forest shadows.

lines.zh: 我黑白条纹，走夜路最显眼。
lines.en: In black and white, I stand out on a night walk.

lines.zh: 我坐着舔前爪，慢慢理毛。
lines.en: I sit and lick my front paws, grooming slowly.

lines.zh: 尾巴一抖一抖，我在听林子。
lines.en: My tail twitches as I listen to the forest.

lines.zh: 风里有狐狸的味道，我不喜欢。
lines.en: There is fox on the wind, and I dislike it.

lines.zh: 我把脸埋进肚子上的软毛。
lines.en: I bury my face in the soft fur of my belly.

lines.zh: 刚才那声树枝断，吓我一跳。
lines.en: That snapping twig a moment ago startled me badly.

lines.zh: 我在数自己还剩几次臭气。
lines.en: I am counting how many sprays I have left.

lines.zh: 太阳落在背上，暖得我想睡。
lines.en: Sun on my back is so warm I could sleep.

lines.zh: 有条虫在爬，我盯着它看。
lines.en: A beetle crawls by, and I watch it closely.

lines.zh: 我不吵，我只是不太敢动。
lines.en: I am not being quiet; I am just afraid to move.

lines.zh: 这块石头底下，藏过我的果子。
lines.en: Under this stone I once hid my berries.

lines.zh: 我今天适合在树荫里躺。
lines.en: Today suits me lying in the shade.

lines.zh: 我盯着蘑菇发呆半天。
lines.en: I stare at a mushroom for ages.

lines.zh: 林子这么静，我慢慢晃过去。
lines.en: The woods are quiet; I will amble across.

lines.zh: 我尾巴搭在落叶上歇着。
lines.en: My tail rests on the fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 我耳朵一抖，是甲虫。
lines.en: My ear twitched. Just a beetle.

lines.zh: 树荫里，我摊开身子。
lines.en: In the shade I sprawl out.

lines.zh: 林子很静，我抬起尾巴示意。
lines.en: The woods are quiet; I lift my tail as a signal.

lines.zh: 天太亮了，我想回洞里。
lines.en: Too bright out. I want my burrow.

lines.zh: 我尾巴抬起来了，退后。
lines.en: My tail is up; stand back.

lines.zh: 林子里站着，不吵也不闹。
lines.en: Standing in the woods, quiet and still.

lines.zh: 我刚才那株草叫啥？
lines.en: What was that plant called again?

lines.zh: 我在想那丛草熟没熟。
lines.en: I'm wondering if that grass has ripened.

lines.zh: 我尾巴抬起来，你最好别靠近。
lines.en: My tail is up; you had better keep back.

lines.zh: 我在树根边窝一会儿。
lines.en: I'll curl up by this root a while.

lines.zh: 我鼻尖上停了只小虫。
lines.en: A little bug has landed on my nose.

lines.zh: 风里有青草味，我还没放味。
lines.en: Grass on the wind, and I have not sprayed.

lines.zh: 我从蕨叶后露出半张脸。
lines.en: I show half my face from behind the ferns.

lines.zh: 你别过来，我尾巴已经抬了。
lines.en: Stay back; my tail is already lifting.

lines.zh: 你的靴子好大，比狐狸还大。
lines.en: Your boots are huge, bigger than any fox.

lines.zh: 我在看你手里有没有浆果。
lines.en: I am checking your hands for sweet berries.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我才敢往前一点。
lines.en: Crouch down, and I might come a little closer.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛一直追着我，我怕。
lines.en: Your eyes keep following me, and that frightens me.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，判断你有多高。
lines.en: I tilt my head and measure how tall you are.

lines.zh: 别伸手，我的手会先抬起来。
lines.en: Don't reach out; my rear will lift first.

lines.zh: 你身上没有野兽的味道，奇怪。
lines.en: You carry no predator smell, which is strange.

lines.zh: 看你一眼，我就要跑了。
lines.en: One more look at you and I am gone.

lines.zh: 尾巴抬起来了，你最好退。
lines.en: My tail is up. You should back off.

lines.zh: 我从你包里闻到果味。
lines.en: I smell fruit from your bag.

lines.zh: 你脚边那丛草是我的。
lines.en: That clump by your feet is mine.

lines.zh: 你要不要留下来闻一会儿？
lines.en: Care to stay and sniff a while?

lines.zh: 林子里这股味，是我留的。
lines.en: That smell in the woods is mine.

lines.zh: 你比我高，可我有后手。
lines.en: You are taller, but I have a backup.

lines.zh: 林子里散步，别挡我。
lines.en: Taking a walk in the woods. Move.

lines.zh: 我这条白纹，你认得吧。
lines.en: You know this white stripe of mine.

lines.zh: 我闻得出你带着铁和汗。
lines.en: I can smell the iron and sweat on you.

lines.zh: 我看你手里没吃的，走吧。
lines.en: I see no food in your hands. Go on.

lines.zh: 站住，别逼我抬起尾巴。
lines.en: Stand still; do not make me raise my tail.

lines.zh: 你站我这么近想干嘛？
lines.en: Why are you standing this close to me?

lines.zh: 你打中我了，我的尾巴立刻举起。
lines.en: You hit me, and my tail shoots straight up.

lines.zh: 我疼得直叫，脚都软了。
lines.en: I squeal with pain; my legs go weak.

lines.zh: 这一下不算重，但我不想再挨。
lines.en: That was not heavy, but I want no more.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，只露出背上的条纹。
lines.en: I curl up, showing only the stripes on my back.

lines.zh: 挨打的时候，我连跑都跑不快。
lines.en: When I am hurt, I cannot even run well.

lines.zh: 你要打就打吧，我要喷了。
lines.en: Hit me if you must; I am about to spray.

lines.zh: 我的肋骨在响，这不太妙。
lines.en: My ribs are clicking, and that is not good.

lines.zh: 疼得我忘了往哪边跑。
lines.en: The pain makes me forget which way to run.

lines.zh: 我倒下了，尾巴还朝天立着。
lines.en: I fall, and my tail still points at the sky.

lines.zh: 你出手之前，我本来想走的。
lines.en: Before you struck, I was about to leave.

lines.zh: 我黑白毛炸成一团。
lines.en: My black-and-white fur puffs out.

lines.zh: 疼得我尾巴直打颤。
lines.en: It hurts; my tail's trembling.

lines.zh: 哎哟，我毛都乱了。
lines.en: Ow, my fur's all ruffled.

lines.zh: 我这一喷，三天散不掉。
lines.en: One spray from me lasts three days.

lines.zh: 味道喷歪了，自己中招。
lines.en: I sprayed wide and got myself.

lines.zh: 这一下，把我从尾巴边撞开。
lines.en: That knocked me off my tail.

lines.zh: 这点味道，洗三次就好。
lines.en: This smell takes three washes.

lines.zh: 让我在草里躺一会儿。
lines.en: Let me lie in the grass a while.

lines.zh: 我疼得尾巴都软了。
lines.en: It hurts so much my tail droops.

lines.zh: 尾巴已经抬起来了，退后。
lines.en: My tail's already up — step back.

lines.zh: 甜浆果的味道，我隔老远就闻到。
lines.en: I smell sweet berries from very far away.

lines.zh: 你口袋里有东西，鼓鼓的。
lines.en: Something in your pocket is bulging.

lines.zh: 我往前挪半步，又退回半步。
lines.en: I take half a step forward and half a step back.

lines.zh: 把果子放在地上，然后退开。
lines.en: Put the berries down, then step away.

lines.zh: 那颗红的，看起来最甜。
lines.en: That red one looks like the sweetest.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转半圈，找机会。
lines.en: I circle halfway around you, looking for a chance.

lines.zh: 你手一抖，我就往后跳。
lines.en: If your hand twitches, I jump backward.

lines.zh: 我饿，可我不敢靠得太近。
lines.en: I am hungry, but I dare not come close.

lines.zh: 别笑，我是认真的在考虑。
lines.en: Don't laugh; I am seriously considering this.

lines.zh: 浆果滚过来，我一口咬住。
lines.en: A berry rolls my way, and I snap it up.

lines.zh: 尾巴一翘，就是要喷了。
lines.en: Tail up means it is coming.

lines.zh: 你举着蘑菇，我就跟着。
lines.en: Hold the mushroom up and I'll follow.

lines.zh: 我尾巴已经抬起来了。
lines.en: My tail is already raised.

lines.zh: 你走慢点，我短腿跟着。
lines.en: Walk slower. These short legs are following.

lines.zh: 尾巴抬起来，你最好现在走。
lines.en: My tail is up. Best leave now.

lines.zh: 尾巴立起来了，你最好走远。
lines.en: Tail up. You'd better back off.

lines.zh: 我还没饿到要靠近你。
lines.en: I am not hungry enough to come closer.

lines.zh: 黑白条纹，是最后一句警告。
lines.en: Black and white is the final warning.

lines.zh: 我抬起尾巴，你最好退开。
lines.en: I lift my tail; you'd better back off.

lines.zh: 你手别缩，再给我拿点。
lines.en: Don't pull your hand back. Fetch me more.

lines.zh: 这蘑菇真给我吃？
lines.en: You're really giving me this mushroom?

lines.zh: 那株草勾住我眼睛了。
lines.en: That plant has my eyes hooked.

lines.zh: 我吃完这株还有吗？
lines.en: Is there more after I finish this one?

lines.zh: 我这条白纹，在黑林里很显眼。
lines.en: My white stripe shows in the dark woods.

lines.zh: 这味道比野草冲多了。
lines.en: That smell is far stronger than weeds.

lines.zh: 你知道我爱吃这些。
lines.en: You know what I like to eat.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的尾巴，我整只弹起来。
lines.en: You step on my tail and I bounce straight up.

lines.zh: 我撞在你腿上，像撞一棵树。
lines.en: I bump your leg like hitting a tree.

lines.zh: 别挤，这里只够一只臭鼬。
lines.en: Don't crowd me; this spot fits one skunk.

lines.zh: 我被你一碰，先抬起后半身。
lines.en: One touch from you and my rear lifts.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我滚进草丛。
lines.en: We collide and I roll into the grass.

lines.zh: 你的脚让一让，我要过去。
lines.en: Move your foot; I need to get past.

lines.zh: 我从你两腿间钻过去，很快。
lines.en: I dart between your legs, quick as that.

lines.zh: 别抓我尾巴，那是我最后的本钱。
lines.en: Don't grab my tail; it is my only defense.

lines.zh: 碰一下我就要叫，你听见了。
lines.en: One bump and I squeak; you heard it.

lines.zh: 我们贴得太近，我喘不上气。
lines.en: We are too close; I cannot catch my breath.

lines.zh: 我站在这儿没挪过窝。
lines.en: I haven't moved from this spot.

lines.zh: 草丛里挤不下我和你了。
lines.en: This brush won't fit both of us.

lines.zh: 再追我，我就喷了。
lines.en: Chase me further and I spray.

lines.zh: 我抬尾巴，你就该跑了。
lines.en: When my tail lifts, you should run.

lines.zh: 我的味道能在林子里留三天。
lines.en: My smell lasts three days in the woods.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，急什么。
lines.en: You bumped me. What's the hurry?

lines.zh: 我今天不喷你，让开吧。
lines.en: I won't spray you today. Move along.

lines.zh: 谁撞的我？站出来。
lines.en: Who bumped me? Step forward.

lines.zh: 就碰一下，我不跟你打。
lines.en: Just a bump. I'm not fighting you.

lines.zh: 都挤什么，我还没过。
lines.en: What's all the shoving? I haven't passed.

lines.zh: 我叼着甜浆果，去找那只条纹。
lines.en: I carry sweet berries to the striped one.

lines.zh: 它在我洞口停下，尾巴竖着。
lines.en: It stops at my den with its tail upright.

lines.zh: 我们把浆果推来推去，谁也不吃。
lines.en: We push berries back and forth and eat none.

lines.zh: 两只臭鼬挤在一起，很暖。
lines.en: Two skunks huddle together, and it is warm.

lines.zh: 它替我理了理背上的毛。
lines.en: It grooms the fur along my back.

lines.zh: 洞里铺了干草，是给它准备的。
lines.en: I lined the den with dry grass for it.

lines.zh: 小家伙出生时，眼睛还没睁开。
lines.en: The little ones are born with their eyes shut.

lines.zh: 我们并排走，条纹对着条纹。
lines.en: We walk side by side, stripe beside stripe.

lines.zh: 它一叫，我就知道要换地方了。
lines.en: One call from it, and I know we must move.

lines.zh: 这一窝，我会守到它们会喷为止。
lines.en: I will guard this litter until they can spray.

lines.zh: 你转过来，看看我条纹。
lines.en: Turn around. Look at my stripes.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴抬高，你就该走了。
lines.en: Tail up means you should leave.

lines.zh: 再陪我闻闻这片草。
lines.en: Stay and sniff this grass with me.

lines.zh: 尾巴先放下，我保证。
lines.en: Tail down first, I promise.

lines.zh: 我看你的条纹也黑白分明。
lines.en: Your stripes are black and white too, I see.

lines.zh: 别急，我等的草不会跑。
lines.en: No rush. The grass I wait for won't run.

lines.zh: 别逼我抬起尾巴。
lines.en: Don't make me lift my tail.

lines.zh: 这片草够我们两家吃。
lines.en: This meadow feeds both our families.

lines.zh: 我留了树根下那丛嫩草。
lines.en: I saved the tender clump under the root.

lines.zh: 森林里那点甜草，分你一半。
lines.en: Half of this sweet grass is yours.

lines.zh: 我叼起一颗浆果，往洞里搬。
lines.en: I pick up a berry and haul it to the den.

lines.zh: 这块亮石头不能吃，我放下。
lines.en: This shiny stone is not food; I put it down.

lines.zh: 一次只能叼一颗，嘴巴太小。
lines.en: One berry at a time; my mouth is small.

lines.zh: 我把果子埋在落叶下面，记着位置。
lines.en: I bury the berries under leaves and remember where.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的东西，我先闻再决定。
lines.en: For anything dropped, I sniff before deciding.

lines.zh: 你给我的，我也要先闻一闻。
lines.en: Even what you offer, I sniff first.

lines.zh: 那块面包我不碰，太干。
lines.en: I leave that bread alone; it is too dry.

lines.zh: 我拖着一根树枝回窝，很费劲。
lines.en: I drag a twig home, and it is hard work.

lines.zh: 我嘴里塞满了，不能再拿了。
lines.en: My mouth is full; I cannot carry more.

lines.zh: 捡东西前，我得先看看四周。
lines.en: Before picking anything up, I check my surroundings.

lines.zh: 咦，我居然也能捡东西。
lines.en: Huh — I can pick things up too.

lines.zh: 这块亮石头归我了。
lines.en: This shiny stone is mine now.

lines.zh: 这果子我带回去喂幼崽。
lines.en: I'll take this berry back to the pups.

lines.zh: 一个不够，再翻翻。
lines.en: One isn't enough — I'll rummage more.

lines.zh: 这蘑菇我叼回窝里。
lines.en: I'll carry this mushroom back to my den.

lines.zh: 我塞进背毛里，没人看见。
lines.en: I tuck it in my back fur where none can see.

lines.zh: 别盯我，我捡点吃的。
lines.en: Don't stare. I'm just foraging.

lines.zh: 我顺路叼的，不碍事。
lines.en: I picked it up in passing. No harm.

lines.zh: 这蘑菇能吃吗？先叼着。
lines.en: Can I eat this mushroom? I'll hold it.

lines.zh: 轻得很，我叼得动。
lines.en: It's light. I can carry it.

lines.zh: 你的影子压过来，我先退两步。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on me; I back off two steps.

lines.zh: 你走得太直，直冲我来了。
lines.en: You are walking straight at me.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我得把尾巴立起来。
lines.en: At this distance, my tail has to go up.

lines.zh: 我一直盯着你的脚，不看脸。
lines.en: I keep watching your feet, never your face.

lines.zh: 林子这么静，你的脚步太响。
lines.en: The forest is quiet; your steps are far too loud.

lines.zh: 我不打，我只警告你一次。
lines.en: I will not fight; I warn you just once.

lines.zh: 你弯腰了，那是最坏的动作。
lines.en: You are bending down; that is the worst move.

lines.zh: 后退的路线我看好了，三条。
lines.en: I have picked my escape routes: three of them.

lines.zh: 你的气味就在我鼻尖上。
lines.en: Your scent is right on the tip of my nose.

lines.zh: 我把重心往后压，尾巴对准你。
lines.en: I settle my weight back and line up my tail.

lines.zh: 再靠近，我的尾巴就要动了。
lines.en: Come closer and my tail will do the talking.

lines.zh: 我的手在抖，但我不退。
lines.en: My paws are shaking, but I hold my ground.

lines.zh: 你挡住了洞口，我没法跑。
lines.en: You are blocking my den, so I cannot run.

lines.zh: 这次我不逃，我转过身了。
lines.en: This time I do not flee; I turn around.

lines.zh: 你踩断的树枝，我听见了。
lines.en: I heard the branch you snapped.

lines.zh: 你走得越来越直，冲我来的。
lines.en: Your path keeps straightening. You are coming for me.

lines.zh: 别动，我尾巴要抬了。
lines.en: Hold still. My tail is coming up.

lines.zh: 我尾巴举起来了，数三下。
lines.en: My tail's up. Counting to three.

lines.zh: 谁踩我那片嫩草地？
lines.en: Who's trampling my tender patch?

lines.zh: 这气味太冲，我憋着气。
lines.en: The smell is so strong I hold my breath.

lines.zh: 先让我用头顶你一下。
lines.en: Let me butt you once first.

lines.zh: 这味道，会跟着你三天。
lines.en: This smell will follow you three days.

lines.zh: 喷一下，这片林子就归我。
lines.en: One spray, and this whole grove is mine.

lines.zh: 再近一步，我就抬尾。
lines.en: One more step and my tail goes up.

lines.zh: 别逼我竖尾巴冲过去。
lines.en: Don't make me charge with my tail up.

lines.zh: 我的味道对准你了。
lines.en: My stink is aimed at you.

lines.zh: 我背对你，把尾巴对准你的脸。
lines.en: I face away and aim my tail at your face.

lines.zh: 风从你那边吹来，正合适。
lines.en: The wind comes from your side; that is perfect.

lines.zh: 我抬脚跺了两下，这是最后警告。
lines.en: I stomp twice; this is your final warning.

lines.zh: 你别绕，我跟着你转。
lines.en: Don't circle; I will turn with you.

lines.zh: 我算好了，三步之内够得着。
lines.en: I have it figured: three steps is close enough.

lines.zh: 我的后半身绷紧了，像拉满的弓。
lines.en: My rear is taut as a drawn bow.

lines.zh: 你抬手挡脸，那也拦不住。
lines.en: Raising your arm to shield your face won't stop it.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的膝盖，那里最合适。
lines.en: I fix on your knees; that is the right height.

lines.zh: 你屏住呼吸也没用，味道会留着。
lines.en: Holding your breath won't help; the smell lingers.

lines.zh: 我在等你先动，我不先动。
lines.en: I wait for you to move first; I will not.

lines.zh: 这根尾巴举起，就没有回头路了。
lines.en: Once this tail is up, there is no going back.

lines.zh: 我数到三，你最好已经走远。
lines.en: I count to three; you had better be gone.

lines.zh: 你的靴子沾着泥，正好对着。
lines.en: Your muddy boots are lined up perfectly.

lines.zh: 别逼我，我其实很怕你。
lines.en: Don't push me; I am truly afraid of you.

lines.zh: 我把屁股转过去，慢慢对准你。
lines.en: I turn my rear toward you, slowly taking aim.

lines.zh: 你绕开那丛灌木，我也不藏了。
lines.en: You go around the bush. I stop hiding.

lines.zh: 碎石在我脚下响，我不装了。
lines.en: Gravel shifts under my feet. No more pretending.

lines.zh: 你先动的手，我记着。
lines.en: You swung first. I remember.

lines.zh: 风向没变，味道会直扑你脸。
lines.en: The wind holds steady. This will hit your face.

lines.zh: 最后三声跺脚，你听见没有。
lines.en: Three last stomps. Did you hear them?

lines.zh: 你听见我的小爪声了吧？
lines.en: You hear my little claws, don't you?

lines.zh: 站住，我有话要说！
lines.en: Stop. I have something to say.

lines.zh: 等等我，短腿跑不快。
lines.en: Wait for me. Short legs don't run fast.

lines.zh: 追完你，我得补一顿草。
lines.en: After chasing you, I'm due a meal of grass.

lines.zh: 让开，我要去那片草。
lines.en: Move, I'm headed for that patch of grass.

lines.zh: 森林里这股味，是我留的。
lines.en: That smell in the forest is my mark.

lines.zh: 尾巴抬起来了，退后。
lines.en: My tail is up — back off.

lines.zh: 你的鞋印出卖了你。
lines.en: Your footprints gave you away.

lines.zh: 我从灌丛里钻过来了。
lines.en: I'm coming out of the brush now.

lines.zh: 我躲在灌丛里，尾巴不动。
lines.en: I crouch in the brush, tail still.

lines.zh: 一股白雾喷出，正中你的胸口。
lines.en: A white mist sprays out and hits your chest.

lines.zh: 你开始反胃了，那是我的味道。
lines.en: You are getting queasy; that is my scent.

lines.zh: 这味道会留在石头上，好几天。
lines.en: This smell will cling to the stone for days.

lines.zh: 我喷完就跑，绝不回头。
lines.en: I spray and run, never looking back.

lines.zh: 你身上的臭味，能装进瓶子里。
lines.en: The stink on you could be bottled.

lines.zh: 附近的野兽会以为是你的错。
lines.en: The nearby beasts will think it was your doing.

lines.zh: 别追了，你越追我喷得越准。
lines.en: Stop chasing; the closer you get, the better I aim.

lines.zh: 我这一下不伤皮肉，只伤鼻子。
lines.en: This blow harms no skin, only nostrils.

lines.zh: 你退开了，我的尾巴还举着。
lines.en: You back away, and my tail stays raised.

lines.zh: 我把最后一点存货都给了你。
lines.en: I gave you the last of my supply.

lines.zh: 现在整片林子都知道你在哪。
lines.en: Now the whole forest knows where you are.

lines.zh: 你擦也没用，它已经渗进去了。
lines.en: Wiping won't help; it has soaked in already.

lines.zh: 我不是凶，我只是没别的办法。
lines.en: I am not fierce; I simply have nothing else.

lines.zh: 喷完这一次，我得躲好几天。
lines.en: After this spray, I must hide for days.

lines.zh: 我抬起尾巴，喷了一股白雾。
lines.en: I lift my tail and spray a white cloud.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛开始流泪，这就对了。
lines.en: Your eyes are watering. Good.

lines.zh: 这味道会跟着你的披风走一天。
lines.en: That smell will ride your cloak all day.

lines.zh: 喷完我转身就跑，腿发软。
lines.en: When it is done I bolt, legs shaking.

lines.zh: 我连最后一点都给了你。
lines.en: I gave you my very last drop.

lines.zh: 别擦，越擦越往毛孔里钻。
lines.en: Do not rub it. It only sinks deeper.

lines.zh: 再来我就转身喷了。
lines.en: Come again and I'll turn and spray.

lines.zh: 我被你撞得眼冒金星。
lines.en: You knocked stars into my eyes.

lines.zh: 尾巴先抬起来，警告你。
lines.en: My tail lifts first. That's your warning.

lines.zh: 这味道要洗三天。
lines.en: This smell takes three days to wash off.

lines.zh: 再靠近一步，我就转身。
lines.en: One more step and I turn around.

lines.zh: 别逼我抬尾巴。
lines.en: Don't make me raise my tail.

lines.zh: 我一般不这样，是你逼的。
lines.en: I don't usually do this. You made me.

lines.zh: 我再顶一下，你就飞了。
lines.en: One more shove from me and you're flying.

lines.zh: 这一喷，三天洗不掉。
lines.en: One spray, and it stays three days.

lines.zh: 我喷歪了，这也算警告。
lines.en: I sprayed wide. That still counts as a warning.

lines.zh: 我从蕨叶底下钻出来，很小一只。
lines.en: I crawl out from under the ferns, very small.

lines.zh: 第一次闻见森林，全是湿土味。
lines.en: My first smell of the forest is wet earth.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖毛，条纹还没长清。
lines.en: I shake my fur; my stripes are still faint.

lines.zh: 妈妈的味道就在附近，我跟着。
lines.en: My mother's scent is nearby, and I follow it.

lines.zh: 这片林子看着很大，我有点怕。
lines.en: This forest looks enormous, and I am a little scared.

lines.zh: 有只鸟在叫，我缩了缩脖子。
lines.en: A bird calls and I duck my head down.

lines.zh: 我把第一颗浆果咬破了，很酸。
lines.en: I bite my first berry open; it is sour.

lines.zh: 尾巴还不听使唤，举不太起来。
lines.en: My tail will not obey yet; it barely lifts.

lines.zh: 我找到一段倒木，钻了进去。
lines.en: I find a fallen log and squeeze inside.

lines.zh: 天黑了，我该学会自己找吃的。
lines.en: It is dark; I must learn to find food alone.

lines.zh: 我在落叶堆里留下第一道气味。
lines.en: I leave my first scent in the leaf litter.

lines.zh: 从这儿开始，每一丛灌木都是路。
lines.en: From here, every bush is a road.

lines.zh: 我想知道这儿有嫩草吗。
lines.en: I'd like to know if there's tender grass here.

lines.zh: 林子里的气味，我全记着。
lines.en: I remember every scent in this forest.

lines.zh: 这地方闻着不错。
lines.en: This place smells fine.

lines.zh: 森林里散开的那股味，是我。
lines.en: That smell spreading through the woods is mine.

lines.zh: 这片林子，我来了。
lines.en: These woods — here I come.

lines.zh: 我能闻到同类的味吗？
lines.en: Can I smell any of my own kind?

lines.zh: 林子里又亮，我该起来了。
lines.en: The woods are bright again. I should get up.

lines.zh: 吱——我这嗓子还行。
lines.en: Squeak — my voice still works.

lines.zh: 鼻子指哪，我就走哪。
lines.en: Wherever my nose points, I go.

lines.zh: 我得先找片草地垫肚子。
lines.en: I need a meadow to fill up on first.

lines.zh: 毛尖卷起来，那味道比我的还难闻。
lines.en: My fur tips curl, and that smell is worse than mine.

lines.zh: 烧焦的毛，味道更冲了。
lines.en: Burnt fur smells even sharper.

lines.zh: 从坡上滚下来，我头都晕了。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and my head spins.

lines.zh: 我从树上摔下来，丢脸。
lines.en: Fell from a tree. Embarrassing.

lines.zh: 我游得不好，水一直往鼻子里钻。
lines.en: I swim badly; water keeps rushing up my nose.

lines.zh: 我这一身味道，连水都洗不掉。
lines.en: Even water won't wash this smell off.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀翻，我四脚朝天。
lines.en: The blast flips me over onto my back.

lines.zh: 我耳朵被震得发麻。
lines.en: My ears are numb from the blast.

lines.zh: 箭扎在尾巴根上，疼得我打转。
lines.en: An arrow sticks near my tail's base and I spin.

lines.zh: 我的黑白条纹是警告。
lines.en: These black and white stripes are a warning.

lines.zh: 一股怪味钻进鼻子，我直打喷嚏。
lines.en: A strange reek crawls up my nose; I sneeze hard.

lines.zh: 这股怪味钻进我毛里。
lines.en: This strange reek soaks into my fur.

lines.zh: 三天没找到浆果，我的肚子贴着背。
lines.en: Three days without berries; my belly touches my spine.

lines.zh: 森林里翻遍了，没吃的。
lines.en: Searched the forest — nothing to eat.

lines.zh: 雷打在树上，我吓得喷了一点。
lines.en: Lightning hits a tree and I spray a little in fright.

lines.zh: 雷劈焦了我半边毛。
lines.en: Lightning singed half my fur.

lines.zh: 一直往下掉，连泥土味都没有了。
lines.en: I keep falling until even the smell of soil is gone.

lines.zh: 我脚下空了，一直往下掉。
lines.en: Nothing underfoot. I keep falling.
